meta.title: Fly64 跨组件契约注册表
meta.purpose: 系统化登记所有跨组件状态载体的契约，确保 write-once-read-many 规范得到程序化执行
rules_in_effect: RULE-19: 不可观测的失败为零容忍 — 任何被构造/维护/消费但从未被至少一个健康组件观测的状态路径视为不可观测的失败，门禁直接拒绝
WORM: 每个状态键在系统生命周期内精确写入一次（生产者），可供多个消费者读取任意次数；无读取者的写入是死写，无写入者的读取是沉默默认值

changelog.change: t7 集成：flow_json 增加 rate_gate_group（forward/turn/jump_rate 及其 *_hz 观测键、gate_*_threshold_hz、jump_not_active）；新增 flow_json.unit_contract（RULE-19 第 8 例：per-tick 比例 vs Hz 阈值）；新增零容忍条目 RULE-19k（单位契约破裂无告警）；producers 锚点从过期行号改为模块路径
sources: fly64/docs/declared-not-implemented.md §2b：RULE-19 第 8 例的决策登记（t3）

bridge_mmap.description: SM64（C）与 Python 脑模型之间的共享内存桥（write-once-read-many）
bridge_mmap.protocol: mmap with seqlock (POSIX shared memory mapped file)

unobservable_failures_zero_tolerance.description: Seqlock stalled > 5 s without consumer feedback — raw frame frozen but code keeps executing
Torn read after 3 retries — mmap seqlock odd flag indicates partial write but consumer has no visibility
heartbeat_ns stale > 250 ms silently interpreted as state=4 (disconnected) — consumer must log when this triggers

flow_json.description: 实时神经流状态（每秒更新，脑模型内部状态的外化快照）

unit_contract.rule: RULE-19 (8th case: declared unit ≠ consumed unit). Closed by t3; registered by t7 (integration).

per_tick_keys.forward_rate: motor-pool spike fraction of the rolling 13-tick (≈250 ms) window, 0.0 ≤ r ≤ 1.0 (model.py step() decode)
per_tick_keys.turn_rate: right_rate − left_rate, same per-tick fraction domain
per_tick_keys.jump_rate: jump-pool spike fraction, same domain; the decoder's own trigger is jump_rate > 0.04/tick

unit_contract.conversion_site: main.py: rate_per_tick_to_hz(rate_per_tick, model.dt) — exactly one conversion per tick, GATE_RATE_DT_DEFAULT=0.02 fallback; the same 1/dt convention as telemetry.py (window count ÷ ticks·dt)
unit_contract.gate_comparison: main.py: gate_open_hz(observed_hz, threshold_hz) — both sides Hz, strict >, boundary belongs to 'closed'
unit_contract.threshold_unit: Hz — skills/brain_tunable_params.json: gate_forward_threshold 0.4..8.0 default 2.0; gate_jump_threshold 2.0..20.0 default 8.0 (maxima kept below Nyquist 1/dt = 50 Hz so a declared threshold stays reachable)
unit_contract.raw_key_policy: the per-tick keys stay published for backward compatibility (scene_context.py / dashboard read them) — they are the SAME pool quantity, not a second semantic
unit_contract.known_divergence: telemetry.py:93-94 (F643 packet gate_jump) compares its own Hz literal 2.0 against the Hz rate: same unit, different source of truth than the schema defaults (residual finding t6-F2 / t4-U3, out of t7 scope)

unobservable_failures_zero_tolerance.description: flow_json 键被写入但无消费者读取（DEAD-WRITE）— 系统在产生不可观测的状态
field 被消费者读取但无生产者写入（SILENT-DEFAULT）— 组件在消费虚构值
bridge_stale=True 但 dashboard/evolution 没有独立的熔断反馈回路
gate/rate 字段的单位契约破裂（8th case）：per-tick 比例(0..1) 与 Hz 阈值直接比较时 gate 恒假或恒真且无告警。单位契约见本合约 unit_contract；同一字段的 per-tick 与 Hz 两种口径必须由单一换算点（rate_per_tick_to_hz）产生，且 gate 两侧同量纲（gate_open_hz）

memory_json.description: 实时内存/空间状态（每秒更新，MemoryController 的外化快照）

unobservable_failures_zero_tolerance.description: memory_json 键被写入但无消费者读取 — 系统在产生不可观测的状态
field 被消费者读取但无生产者写入 — 组件在消费虚构默认值

active_strategy_json.description: 当前激活的教练参数策略（由 LLM 教练写入，main.py 热加载消费）
active_strategy_json.contract_type: JSON file (write: strategy_writer.py / llm_consult.py, read: main.py / instinct_bindings.py)

exploration.bold_turn_bias: float — turn bias for bold exploration mode
exploration.exploration.bold_explore_stuck_s: float — stuck timeout for bold explore
exploration.exploration.revisit_penalty_scale: float — penalty multiplier for revisiting cells
exploration.exploration.stuck_ramp_cooldown: float — cooldown after stuck on ramp
exploration.exploration.visual_gain_novelty_boost: float — novelty boost to visual gain

escape.escape.commit_ticks: float — commit tick count for escape

unobservable_failures_zero_tolerance.description: SECTION_SPECS 中宣传的参数消费者从未读取（如 escape.reverse_seconds）— 教练在调节无效果的旋钮
sanitize_strategy 允许死键传播到 active_strategy.json — 测试必须验证消毒函数丢弃了未注册的键
active_strategy.json 中的键在 hot-reload 后未被任何行为代码读取 — 参数写入了但未生效

bridge_mmap → flow_json.description: flow_json.bridge_stale 从 SharedBridge.stale 派生；flow_json.pos_y / cell_x / cell_z 从 mmap pose 块派生

flow_json → active_strategy_json.description: flow_json.coach_applied.* 展示 active_strategy.json 经 hot-reload 后的实际生效值
flow_json → active_strategy_json.propagation_delay: 实时（hot-reload 后下一 tick 更新）

flow_json → evolution_skill.description: EvolutionSkill 读取 flow_json 的 80+ 信号字段用于 pattern matching

memory_json → evolution_skill.description: EvolutionSkill 读取 memory_json 的 spatial/memory 字段用于 pattern matching

rule_19_reinforcement.rule: contract_gate 门禁在每次 CI 中运行 audit_contract_pairs.py，如果有 DEAD-WRITE 或 SILENT-DEFAULT 标记的键，门禁拒绝
rule_19_reinforcement.rationale: 任何 DEAD-WRITE 意味着系统在产生不可观测的状态（RULE-19）

rule_19_reinforcement.rule: 每个注册过的契约（bridge_mmap / flow_json / memory_json / active_strategy_json）必须有其生产者代码变更时对应的消费者也变更或更新契约注册表
rule_19_reinforcement.rationale: 单方面变更生产者而不更新消费者的注册导致不可观测的失败

rule_19_reinforcement.rule: active_strategy.json 中 SECTION_SPECS 宣传的每个策略参数必须在 brain 代码中有文字 READ 位置
rule_19_reinforcement.rationale: 教练宣传可调参数但脑模型不消费 = 不可观测的失败（实测案: escape.reverse_seconds）

rule_19_reinforcement.rule: bridge mmap 的 seqlock 停滞 > 5 s 时 flow_json.bridge_stale 必须立即反映，且 dashboard 必须显示不可忽略的警示
rule_19_reinforcement.rationale: SM64 已死但脑模型继续运行 = 不可观测的失败

rule_19_reinforcement.rule: 新引入的跨组件状态载体必须在此契约注册表中登记，否则 CI 门禁拒绝
rule_19_reinforcement.rationale: 未登记的契约不在审计范围内，会产生不可观测的失败盲区
